games.title: POKEMON BLUE
games.description: Catch, train, and battle Pokémon in the Kanto region. One of the original Pokémon games that started the global phenomenon.

games.title: POKEMON RED
games.description: The companion to Pokémon Blue, featuring exclusive Pokémon and the same beloved gameplay.

games.title: POKEMON YELLOW
games.full_name: Pokémon Yellow Version: Special Pikachu Edition
games.description: Enhanced version based on the anime, with Pikachu as your starter Pokémon following you around.

games.title: ZELDA
games.full_name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
games.description: Link awakens on a mysterious island and must find a way to escape. A classic Zelda adventure.

games.title: SUPER MARIOLAND
games.description: Mario's first Game Boy adventure in the exotic Sarasaland. Classic platforming action.

games.title: TETRIS
games.description: The legendary puzzle game that helped make the Game Boy a success. Arrange falling blocks to clear lines.

games.title: KIRBY
games.description: Kirby's debut adventure. Inhale enemies and float through Dream Land to save the day.

games.title: METROID2
games.description: Samus returns to planet SR388 to exterminate the Metroid threat. Exploration and action combined.

games.title: DONKEY KONG
games.description: Mario must rescue Pauline from Donkey Kong in this puzzle-platformer remake of the arcade classic.

games.title: DUCKTALES
games.description: Join Scrooge McDuck on a treasure-hunting adventure across the world. Pogo-stick your way to riches!

games.title: MEGA MAN
games.description: The Blue Bomber's first Game Boy adventure. Defeat Robot Masters and steal their weapons.

games.title: CASTLEVANIA
games.description: Christopher Belmont battles Dracula in this challenging platformer. Whip your way through Transylvania.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY
games.description: The first game in the Mana series. Action-RPG gameplay with a compelling story.

games.title: WARIO LAND
games.description: Wario's first starring role. Collect coins and treasures in this unique platformer.

games.title: POKEMON GOLD
games.description: Explore the Johto region with 100 new Pokémon, day/night cycles, and breeding mechanics.

games.title: POKEMON SILVER
games.description: The companion to Pokémon Gold with exclusive Pokémon and the same enhanced features.

games.title: POKEMON CRYSTAL
games.description: Enhanced version of Gold/Silver with animated sprites and the Battle Tower.
